titleEn: Number of Burgers with No Waste of Ingredients
title: 不浪费原料的汉堡制作方案
summary: 巨无霸需四片番茄和一片奶酪，小皇堡需两片番茄和一片奶酪，求恰好用完原料时两种汉堡数量。
insight: 设 jumbo=x、small=y，则 x+y=cheese、4x+2y=tomato，解得 x=(tomato-2cheese)/2、y=cheese-x；只需验证整除与非负。
pitfalls: 番茄差必须是非负偶数
两种汉堡数量都不能为负

solutions.title: 二元方程闭式解
solutions.idea: 直接解出两种汉堡数量并校验。
steps: 若 difference<0 或为奇数返回空
jumbo=difference/2，small=cheese-jumbo；若 small<0 返回空，否则返回 [jumbo,small]

code.java: class Solution { public List<Integer> numOfBurgers(int tomatoSlices,int cheeseSlices){int difference=tomatoSlices-2*cheeseSlices;if(difference<0||difference%2!=0)return new ArrayList<>();int jumbo=difference/2,small=cheeseSlices-jumbo;if(small<0)return new ArrayList<>();return Arrays.asList(jumbo,small);} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun numOfBurgers(tomatoSlices:Int,cheeseSlices:Int):List<Int>{val difference=tomatoSlices-2*cheeseSlices;if(difference<0||difference%2!=0)return emptyList();val jumbo=difference/2;val small=cheeseSlices-jumbo;return if(small<0)emptyList() else listOf(jumbo,small)} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: vector<int> numOfBurgers(int tomatoSlices,int cheeseSlices){int difference=tomatoSlices-2*cheeseSlices;if(difference<0||difference%2)return {};int jumbo=difference/2,small=cheeseSlices-jumbo;if(small<0)return {};return {jumbo,small};} };
